summary: Backend regression for 9x Security engine de-dup fix (user bug: 'car ka Entry aaya, uske baad JCB/agli car ka nahi aaya - continuity nahi hai'). Ran the two pytest groups specified in the review, reviewed the 3 new engine tests in test_tracker_false_crossings.py, and added 3 new custom scenarios in test_custom_scenarios.py using the shared _engine/_ScriptDet/_Clock/_drive helpers. All tests pass (53 + 21 = 74). Engine service is up on 127.0.0.1:8971.

test_results.group1 (test_tracker_false_crossings + t: 53/53 passed in 19.41s (was 50 in iter22; +3 new custom scenarios test_e/test_f/test_g)
test_results.review of the 3 new engine dedupe tests: test_engine_drops_recreated_track_duplicate (uses tracker.lost path via 25 empty frames > max_disappeared=20; stopped bbox y=224 outside near_band so appeared-at-line does not re-fire), test_engine_counts_following_vehicles_through_the_same_gate (exercises both live-track-deeper and lost-far-away not-a-duplicate branches with 3 vehicles), test_engine_second_box_on_same_truck_is_one_event (two overlapping YOLO boxes on one long truck -> live-overlap dedup branch). All three deterministically monkeypatch engine.time.time via _Clock. Correctly cover the intended scenarios.
test_results.new custom scenarios (test_custom_scenar: test_e: v1 crosses and stays visible deeper in yard (track never lost); v2 crosses ~5s later at same spot -> 2 Entry events (same direction, dedupe correctly bypassed by live-track-elsewhere branch). test_f: same vehicle crosses, stops at bottom=224 (past line ~132), detector drops for 25 frames (>max_disappeared=20), re-detected at same spot, drives on -> 1 event (tracker.lost path). test_g: Entry then a different vehicle Exits ~6s later at the same spot -> 2 events with different directions (dedupe is same-direction only).

critical_code_review_comments: engine.py:507 _duplicate_reason pre-filters with `_box_iou(box, cr['bbox']) <= 0.25` where `box` is the ORIGINAL crossing's bbox (captured near the line). For the 'track re-created at the same spot' branch this can miss legitimate duplicates when a vehicle stops inside near_band (~54px of line): the recreated track's appeared-at-line fires with a bbox further past the line that no longer overlaps the on-line crossing bbox. Reproducer: cross with _cross_frames(60,220), stop at bbox (720,98,840,178) (bottom=178, 46px past line, within near_band), drop 25 frames, re-detect at same spot, move to bottom>=214 -> a spurious 2nd Entry fires because the IoU pre-filter short-circuits before the tracker.lost IoU check. Consider ORing the pre-filter with `iou(self.tracker.lost.get(tid,(None,))[0] or box, cr['bbox']) > 0.25` so the lost bbox (which is where the vehicle actually stopped) participates in the initial gate. Current test in test_tracker_false_crossings.py hides this because it stops at bottom=224 (91px past line, outside near_band, so appeared-at-line never re-fires).

engine.py:494 self._recent_cross is trimmed by DEDUPE_S (20s) but appends grow inside the loop. For very high-crossing scenes list stays small (bounded by 20s window) - acceptable but consider a deque with maxlen.
tracker.py:239 self.lost is trimmed by 120s TTL - engines can accumulate entries between trims if update() is not called; benign, mention only for completeness.

rca of the issue: User bug: after car Entry, following JCB and car at same gate spot did not alert. Root cause was engine._dedupe_crossings dropping ANY same-direction crossing whose bbox overlapped a recent counted crossing (IoU>0.25) within DEDUPE_S=20s - so consecutive vehicles at the same gate spot were mis-classified as duplicates. Fix in this iteration adds DEDUPE_FAST_S=2.5 for flicker/second-box, requires the earlier track to still be alive and IoU>0.3 with current live bbox to treat as 'second box on same truck', or an aged-out track (tracker.lost) with IoU>0.25 to treat as 'track re-created at the same spot'. Otherwise the new crossing counts. Verified end-to-end in test_e (following vehicle while first still tracked deeper -> 2 events) and test_engine_counts_following_vehicles_through_the_same_gate (car -> JCB -> car all count).
